name: outlook
description: Use Microsoft Outlook (classic desktop) end-to-end from your agent (Claude Code, Cowork, Copilot, Cursor, and other plugin-compatible agents) — read, search, triage, draft mail (draft-only by default; threaded reply drafts, signatures); find meeting times with colleagues via free/busy; manage calendar events and meeting invites; work with contacts, tasks, color categories, and mail rules; check Out-of-Office. Bundles the outlook-classic-mcp local MCP server and the operational skill that teaches the agent how to drive it. Windows + classic Outlook only; installs its own runtime (uv/Python) on first use.

author.name: Ori Harel (fork of Anas Ahmed Shaikh's outlook-classic-mcp)
